text:
For an **independent upper-upscale hotel in Mexico**, I would invite the following brands into a first-round conversion RFP. The best choice depends heavily on whether the property is urban, historic/boutique, resort, or all-inclusive.

## Recommended shortlist

| Brand/affiliation | Best fit | Owner considerations |
|---|---|---|
| **Autograph Collection or Tribute Portfolio — Marriott** | Distinctive full-service urban hotel, boutique resort, historic property, or all-inclusive resort | Usually the strongest starting point when U.S. demand, group business and Marriott Bonvoy distribution matter. Both preserve an independent identity, although Marriott will require a coherent concept, guest experience and PIP. Marriott currently operates Autograph properties in Mexico, including conventional boutique hotels and all-inclusive resorts. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Curio Collection by Hilton** | Upper-upscale lifestyle hotel or resort with strong design, F&B and local storytelling | Probably the closest direct competitor to Autograph. It combines individual identity with Hilton’s distribution, technology and Honors program. Hilton is actively pursuing Mexican conversions; Amàre Cancún is scheduled to convert to Curio on October 31, 2026. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/curio-collection-by-hilton-fact-sheet?utm_source=openai)) |
| **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Exceptional boutique, heritage or destination resort capable of approaching luxury rates | Strong choice when the hotel’s story and experience are unusually distinctive. Hyatt explicitly positions Unbound across upper-upscale and luxury, and the collection already has Mexican properties such as NUMU in San Miguel de Allende. It may be more selective than broader conversion brands. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **MGallery Collection — Accor** | Design-led boutique, historic urban hotel, wellness property or culturally rooted resort | Particularly relevant when European, Canadian and Latin American source markets matter. Accor identifies MGallery as upper-upscale and prioritizes conversions that preserve each hotel’s identity. Confirm Accor’s ability to generate meaningful demand in the property’s specific Mexican market. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/brands-and-experiences/our-hotel-brands/mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Registry Collection Hotels — Wyndham** | Upper-upscale resort, especially all-inclusive, leisure or residentially oriented | Registry is explicitly positioned as an upper-upscale soft brand. Wyndham already uses it in Mexico, including Costa Mujeres, making it especially credible for large leisure resorts. Compare its achievable ADR premium and loyalty contribution carefully against Marriott and Hilton. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **voco — IHG** | More conventional upper-upscale urban or resort hotel where conversion cost and speed are priorities | Less “independent collection” and more flexible conversion flag. IHG markets voco around limited standards, lower conversion capital and quick access to IHG One Rewards; voco Ciudad de México Reforma provides a local precedent. This can be attractive when the building is good but the hotel lacks the singular story required by Autograph, Curio or Unbound. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/voco-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |

## Situational alternatives

### Vignette Collection — IHG

Consider Vignette if the owner intends to reposition the property toward **luxury**, rather than remain strictly upper-upscale. It is designed for independent conversions that retain their existing name, design and identity. Because IHG classifies Vignette as luxury, its standards and capital expectations may exceed the optimal level for a conventional upper-upscale asset. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai))

### Preferred Hotels & Resorts

Preferred should be included as a **lower-intervention affiliation alternative**, not treated as directly equivalent to a major-chain franchise. It allows the hotel to remain substantially independent while obtaining distribution, sales, marketing and the I Prefer loyalty platform. Preferred has a deep Mexican portfolio covering city hotels, boutiques and major resorts. It can be particularly attractive when the hotel already has strong management and brand equity and primarily needs broader distribution. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))

### Luxury Collection, LXR or Emblems Collection

Only pursue these if a feasibility study supports a genuine **luxury repositioning**, including the required room product, service ratios, F&B, wellness and achievable ADR. Over-branding an upper-upscale hotel into a luxury collection can create an uneconomic PIP without producing a corresponding rate increase.

## My practical ranking by hotel type

### Urban business/lifestyle hotel
1. Curio Collection  
2. Autograph Collection or Tribute Portfolio  
3. voco  
4. MGallery  
5. Unbound, if truly distinctive  

### Historic or boutique destination hotel
1. Autograph Collection  
2. Unbound Collection  
3. Curio Collection  
4. MGallery  
5. Preferred Hotels & Resorts  

### Beach resort or all-inclusive
1. Autograph Collection  
2. Curio Collection  
3. Registry Collection  
4. Preferred Hotels & Resorts  
5. Vignette, if repositioning to luxury  

### Owner prioritizing low capital and operating flexibility
1. Preferred Hotels & Resorts  
2. voco  
3. Registry Collection  
4. Tribute Portfolio  
5. Curio or Autograph  

## How the owner should select

Ask at least four candidates to provide a **10-year, property-specific underwriting**, not simply a brand presentation. Compare:

- Total PIP and required pre-opening closure
- Initial, royalty, marketing, reservation, loyalty and technology fees
- Net rooms revenue after loyalty reimbursement and channel costs
- Brand contribution by geographic source market
- Expected ADR and occupancy lift versus remaining independent
- Group, corporate and wholesale production
- Franchise versus management availability
- Required third-party operator and operator approval rights
- Agreement term, renewal, termination and liquidated damages
- Area protection and competing-brand restrictions
- Key money, fee ramps or renovation support
- Owner approval rights over design, F&B and hotel naming
- All-inclusive, residences and vacation-ownership compatibility, where applicable

**Bottom line:** For most upper-upscale Mexican hotels, the core competitive set should be **Marriott Autograph/Tribute, Hilton Curio, Hyatt Unbound and Accor MGallery**. Add **Registry** for resorts, **voco** for a capital-efficient conversion, and **Preferred** as the independence-preserving benchmark. The decision should ultimately be based on each brand’s incremental EBITDA and asset-value impact—not its gross reservation contribution alone.

5. Curio or Autograph  

## How the owner should select

Ask at least four candidates to provide a **10-year, property-specific underwriting**, not simply a brand presentation. Compare:

- Total PIP and required pre-opening closure
- Initial, royalty, marketing, reservation, loyalty and technology fees
- Net rooms revenue after loyalty reimbursement and channel costs
- Brand contribution by geographic source market
- Expected ADR and occupancy lift versus remaining independent
- Group, corporate and wholesale production
- Franchise versus management availability
- Required third-party operator and operator approval rights
- Agreement term, renewal, termination and liquidated damages
- Area protection and competing-brand restrictions
- Key money, fee ramps or renovation support
- Owner approval rights over design, F&B and hotel naming
- All-inclusive, residences and vacation-ownership compatibility, where applicable

**Bottom line:** For most upper-upscale Mexican hotels, the core competitive set should be **Marriott Autograph/Tribute, Hilton Curio, Hyatt Unbound and Accor MGallery**. Add **Registry** for resorts, **voco** for a capital-efficient conversion, and **Preferred** as the independence-preserving benchmark. The decision should ultimately be based on each brand’s incremental EBITDA and asset-value impact—not its gross reservation contribution alone.
